beats.say: Mark Allen is the only player to have made maximum breaks in all three Triple Crown tournaments.
In 2002, he won the Irish U16, U18 and U19 titles in one weekend.
He won the European Championship and World Amateur Championship in 2004 as an amateur.
Allen won his first ranking title at the 2012 World Open by defeating Stephen Lee 10 to 1.
He later won the 2018 Masters by defeating Kyren Wilson 10 to 7.
